title: feat(connector-mcp): an OAuth-protected MCP server is connected through the MCP authorization flow and dispatched with each organization's token (ADR-0143 S2)
body:
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoHgewSpchhjBvPu7yhxUUJx)_ Part of #26702 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: semantic Skills-docs: the skills half (skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md) is #28299, the skills lane's card; content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx is updated here. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：内置 `mcp` 连接器现在也能调用需要 OAuth 的 MCP 服务器（如 Notion、HubSpot 的 MCP）。管理员点「连接」时，平台自动发现对方的授权服务器、注册客户端（或使用声明的 `clientId`），之后每个组织用自己的令牌、自己的会话调用。 - 为什么改：#28399 已让 `rest` / `openapi` 接入凭证句柄，但 `mcp` 实例仍只能降级；ADR-0143 S2 要求 MCP 按其授权规范在 http 上完成发现、动态注册和 PKCE。 - 风险与回滚：只影响在 `mcp` 上声明了 `oauth2` / `app-credential` 的实例（原来都是降级状态）；`sys_connector_connection` 新增一个加密字段 `registered_client`；静态凭证的 `mcp` 实例行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR，这些实例回到降级。 - 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/oauth2-grant/mcp-authorization.ts`（发现与注册）、`plugin.ts` 中 `mcpAuthorizationClient` 与 `askingDuringMaterializationAs`（按裁定 B 选列工具的连接）、`packages/connectors/connector-mcp/src/mcp-provider.ts`（每次请求取令牌、每组织一个会话）。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/connector-mcp-authorization-door.test.ts`，预期 14 个用例全部通过，其中包括三个组织依次连接、最早连接的组织撤销后改用下一个组织列工具的端到端用例。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地（新增连接表字段，契约复审由席位安排）。 ## What changes ADR-0143 S2, second half: the `mcp` provider. #28399 served `oauth2` and `app-credential` through the credential handle on `rest` and `openapi`; an `mcp` instance with either kind was still held degraded, and an `authorization_code` instance that left its endpoints to discovery was "not served". **`@objectstack/service-automation`: the MCP authorization flow at connect** - `oauth2-grant/mcp-authorization.ts` runs the flow for an `authorization_code` instance on `provider: 'mcp'` over `http` that leaves its endpoints or client undeclared: - Protected-resource metadata (RFC 9728), path-aware then root; its `resource` must be the declared server (same origin, equal or a prefix), and its first authorization server must be https. - Authorization-server metadata (RFC 8414, then OpenID Connect discovery); the `issuer` must equal the one asked for, and `S256` must be listed. - Dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) as a public client (`token_endpoint_auth_method: none`) for the deployment's redirect URI. A declared `clientId` skips registration (the pre-registered form). No registration endpoint and no `clientId` is refused, naming the form. - Declared fields win over discovered ones. Every URL must be https (loopback http only); no request follows a redirect; a server that does not answer, or answers `429` / `5xx`, is `CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE` (the door's `503`), and a missing or failing document is a `400`. A refusal names only the step and, for registration, the RFC 7591 error code, never the server's text. - `plugin.ts`, the connect flow (`beginConnectorConnection` / `completeConnectorConnection`): the authorization URL, the code exchange and every refresh use the discovered endpoints and client, and carry the resource indicator (RFC 8707). A callback whose `iss` differs from the discovered issuer is refused before its code is exchanged (RFC 9207). A reconnect reuses the client the organization's row keeps instead of registering again. - `sys_connector_connection` gains **`registered_client`**, a `Field.secret` (encrypted, masked) holding the discovered endpoints, the client id and any client secret the registration issued. A declared client's secret stays behind its `credentialRef` and is not copied in. `ConnectorConnectionStore.connect` writes it; `resolveRegisteredClient` reads it. - `oauth2-grant/grant-handle.ts`: `tokenUrl` / `clientId` are optional for an `authorization_code` instance; a refresh uses the declared client or the client the connection keeps, and a connection that keeps none is "reconnect required". - The materializer guard: an `oauth2` instance on `mcp` over `http` may leave its endpoints and client to discovery; one whose transport `url` is not https stays degraded with that reason. **Discovery organization, ruled B (ruling record 6545215904 on #26702)** - An `mcp` instance lists its tools at materialization, outside any run. While an `authorization_code` instance materializes, an ask that names no organization is answered as the connection with the **earliest `connected_at`** (ties by organization id); after the factory answers, such an ask is answered as D4 answers a run with none (the only connection, or `422` when there are several). Every dispatch still asks in its own run's organization. - That organization joins the `mcp` instance's reconcile signature, so when its connection is revoked, refused or connected again, the instance materializes again and lists as the next one. `rest` / `openapi` signatures are unchanged. **`@objectstack/connector-mcp`** - The plugin registers the provider with `{ credentialHandle: true }`. - With a handle, over `http`, every HTTP request of the MCP session goes through a fetch that asks the handle (`callWithBorrowedCredential`): a `401` refreshes once and is sent once more; a second `401` is the seam's `503` naming the instance. - Each organization a dispatch runs for opens its own MCP session with its own token; a session that failed to open is not kept; closing the instance closes every session. A dispatch with no organization goes through the session the tools were listed with. - A handle on a stdio transport, or beside a static credential or a request signer, is refused (a configuration fault). - `@objectstack/types` becomes a dependency; the vitest config aliases it to source (`check:test-source-alias`). **Docs**: `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`: the `mcp` provider leaves the "not served yet" paragraph and the failure-table row; the grant-bearing section gains the `mcp` paragraph (http only, per-organization sessions, the earliest-connection listing rule) and the MCP authorization flow; the revoke sentence no longer points at the discovery as future work. ## Tests - `service-automation/src/connector-mcp-authorization-door.test.ts` (14), over ObjectQL on SQLite and a local metadata / authorization / token server: DCR end to end (refresh with the kept client), reconnect reuse, an issued client secret never surfaced, the pre-registered form, `iss` mismatch refused and match accepted, no `S256`, issuer mismatch, resource mismatch, no registration endpoint, a server that does not answer (`503`), a non-https server not served, the `client_credentials` control, and **ruling B**: three organizations connect, the listing stays with the oldest, a dispatch uses its own organization, a run with none is `422`, and revoking the oldest re-materializes and lists as the next while two stay connected. - `service-automation/src/oauth2-grant/mcp-authorization.test.ts` (8): discovery order and the transport refusals. - `service-automation/src/oauth2-grant/grant-handle.test.ts`: four kept-client cases. - `connector-mcp/src/mcp-provider-credential-handle.test.ts` (8), over a real Streamable-HTTP server and the real SDK client: discovery request, per-organization sessions, 401 refresh-once, second 401, a failed session not kept, close, stdio and static refusals, the plugin opt-in.
Ablations — 25, each red and each restored (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, git diff HEAD empty after each) | # | Mutation | Red | |---|---|---| | b01 | drop the RFC 9207 `iss` check | the issuer-mismatch callback pin | | b02 | drop the `S256` requirement | the no-S256 pin | | b03 | drop the issuer equality check | the issuer-mismatch metadata pin | | b04 | drop the protected-resource `resource` check | the resource-mismatch pin | | b05 | accept a non-https server URL in discovery | the unit pin: refused before anything is fetched | | b05b | drop the non-https transport reason in the guard | the not-served pin | | b06 | accept a non-https authorization server | the unit pin: refused before its metadata is fetched | | b07 | drop `redirect: 'error'` on metadata fetches | the discovery-order unit case, which asserts every fetch refuses redirects | | b08 | drop the registered-code filter on a refused registration | the unit pin: only an RFC 7591 code, never the server's text | | b09 | drop the no-answer → upstream-unavailable mapping | the unit pin: no answer, `429` or `5xx` is operational and quotes nothing sent | | b10 | keep a declared client's secret in the kept client | the pre-registered-form door pin | | b11 | never reuse the kept client on reconnect | the reconnect-reuse pin | | b12 | refresh without reading the kept client | two grant-handle pins (kept endpoint and client; per-organization client) | | b13 | put the registered client in the connect log line | the issued-secret pin (never surfaced) | | c01 | every dispatch through the listing session | the per-organization session and refresh-once pins | | c02 | a get-only fetch (no refresh on 401) | the refresh-once pin | | c03 | accept a handle on stdio | the stdio refusal pin | | c04 | accept a handle beside a static credential | the exclusivity pin | | c05 | keep a session that failed to open | the failed-session pin | | c06 | close only the discovery session | the close pin | | c07 | plugin `credentialHandle: false` | the opt-in pin | | d01 | B: pass a no-organization ask through while materializing | ruling B (the re-listing as org_b fails) | | d02 | B: never settle (materialization answering stays on) | ruling B (a no-organization run resolves instead of `422`) | | d03 | B: drop the discovery organization from the mcp signature | ruling B (no re-materialization on the oldest's revoke) | | d04 | B: pick the latest connection | ruling B (re-materializes on each connect) |
## Verification - Whole package suites before the last rebase (onto `630b4078`, which brought only comment changes to `plugin.ts` and `mcp-provider.ts` and a `connectors.mdx` hunk elsewhere on the page): service-automation 246 files / 3131 passed; connector-mcp 6 / 64; connector-rest 5 / 43; connector-openapi 7 / 89. - `pnpm --filter run typecheck` (with `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0 for connector-mcp and service-automation. - eslint on the touched sources: exit 0. - `dispatch-gates --commands`: 104 families, all exit 0 after a whole-tree `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'`; `--ran` reconcile: 104 derived, 104 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun. - After the rebase, on head `5021bd3d`: both typechecks, the door and `oauth2-grant` suites, the connector-mcp suite, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-transcript-drift` and `check:doc-security-posture` re-run, all exit 0. ## Acceptance notes - **Size**: about 1,930 added lines, over the order's ~1,500. This PR is already the per-provider split (S2's second half). Roughly 1,000 of the lines are tests, and the rest is one flow (discovery, registration, the kept client and the provider) that does not split further without landing half of a connect. - **Contract review**: owed. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, and `sys_connector_connection` gains a column (`registered_client`). - **Not measured live** against a vendor's MCP server (Notion, HubSpot); the flow is pinned against a local server that follows the RFCs. - **Unchanged**: the connection door handlers' routes and `capabilities.ts`; datasource lending of grant-bearing kinds is still refused with `422`; a revoke still does not call a revocation endpoint (none is read). ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` is not touched.) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint passes on the touched sources. - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset (`.changeset/26702-connector-mcp-oauth.md`), and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched. - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01L9qibwa6RkD7A2gK6rYRNT
